convert_edp_to_contextual_bandit_log: convert an EvaluationDataPage into a BanditsEstimatorInput for contextual bandit offline policy evaluation
estimate_cpe_with_dm_estimator: estimate counterfactual policy evaluation using the direct method estimator on an EvaluationDataPage
estimate_cpe_with_dr_estimator: estimate counterfactual policy evaluation using the doubly robust estimator on an EvaluationDataPage
